criativos.title: SEAL-Tested Survival Filter [58192]
criativos.bodyText:
Twenty-two years in the Navy SEALs. First lesson they drilled into us: plan water before you plan ammo. You get three days without it. That's it.

So when our water systems started getting hit, 40+ towns in Minnesota this year, I paid attention. "Just a warning," they said. Maybe. 

But the tap is the one thing nobody plans for until it stops.

That's why this straw lives in my truck, my kitchen, and the cabin, it turns whatever water you can find into something your family can drink.

✅ Doesn't clog — works the 2nd, 10th, 200th time
✅ 0.01 micron membrane — 20× finer than a standard hiking straw
✅ Activated carbon stage — chemicals, sediment, taste and odour
✅ 1,800 gallons from one straw — no cartridges, no refills, ever
✅ No expiry date — store it 10+ years, it's still ready
✅ Screws onto any bottle, or hang it up as a gravity filter

Link below. 

Sort it before you need it...

criativos.title: When the Taps Run Dry, This Still Works [02969]
criativos.bodyText:
Most families find out their emergency water plan doesn't work on the day the tap stops.

The shelves are cleared of bottled water in a few hours. The power's out, so boiling isn't an option. And the pumps and treatment plant that fill your glass all run on electricity.

The Blackout Survival Straw sits in a kitchen drawer until that day comes.

✔️ 0.01 micron membrane stops bacteria and parasites
✔️ Carbon stage for chemicals, sediment and taste
✔️ 1,800 gallons from a single straw
✔️ No batteries, no power, no parts to replace
✔️ Stores 10+ years, ready when you need it

One per person. A 5-pack covers the whole house.

If you're a parent or grandparent, sort this before you need it, not during.
